title: @rethunk/mcp-multi-root-git: batch_commit
description: Parameter schema for the 'batch_commit' MCP tool.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

path.description: File path relative to git root.

lineFrom.description: Start line number (1-indexed). Only hunks overlapping [lineFrom, lineTo] are staged.

files.description: Paths to stage, relative to git root. String or `{ path, lineFrom, lineTo }` for hunk-level staging. Each path is staged individually (`git add` / `git apply --cached` / `git rm --cached`). Deleted tracked files are staged via `git rm --cached`. Cannot combine `lineFrom`/`lineTo` with a deleted file. Rejects `.`, the repo root, and directory pathspecs.

commits.description: Ordered list of commits to create.

push.description: `never` (default): no push. `after`: push current branch to upstream after all commits succeed; fails with `push_no_upstream` if no upstream (commits are NOT rolled back).

dryRun.description: Stage files and return a preview without writing commits; restores the index afterwards. Response is marked DRY RUN.
